text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I see you are an 8-month-old boy having trouble feeding and your tummy looks swollen. To understand what is wrong, can you tell me if you are vomiting, and if so, is it coming up like a fountain?

speaker: Patient
text: The baby has been very fussy, feeding less than usual, and the abdomen looks distended. Crying gets worse when the belly is touched.

speaker: Doctor

The X-ray showing dilated bowel segments and no gas in the rectum strongly suggests a mechanical obstruction. To differentiate between Hirschsprung's disease, volvulus, or intussusception, I need to know if you have noticed any episodes of "currant jelly" stool (mucus and blood) or if the abdomen feels like it has a sausage-shaped mass when I press gently.
